summary: Revision 9 (final) of the PDFPundit implementation plan. The panel's four planning files are internally consistent (every decision ref resolves; one canonical destination text; private-identifier grep clean). 51 tickets in dependency order: 48 buildable now (T-01 … T-32b, plus T-31), 3 blocked on user decisions or an undesigned schema (T-33 custody: D-016; T-34 OCR: D-050; T-35 release: D-046 + D-065). Critical path to a running cat: T-01 → T-02 → T-02b → T-15 → T-16 → T-23a → T-23b (the UI lane T-00, T-17…T-22b, T-24 joins at T-23a; the engine lane T-03a…T-14 replaces the stub bodies when it lands; fonts T-27a/b/c → T-29 → T-28 → T-30; benchmark T-25 → T-26 → T-38a/b; export T-32a/b). Seven tickets proceed at-risk on a user decision with bounded, named rework (T-01/D-003, T-26/D-002, T-23a+T-21/D-004, T-15/D-005 and D-062, T-29+T-28/D-021, T-21…T-37/D-045). 19 user decisions are logged with recommended answers (the eighteen-item summary in decision-log.md), 51 reversible defaults, 3 research-pending (D-009 calibration, D-058 Windows legs via the first windows-latest run, D-071 the OCR apparatus for the PR #19 board). Eight AFK tasks need no user: corpus clone, asset staging (already fetched, hash-verified), test binaries + bench files, the OCR lock, fact requests eng-r4-fr1/FR-13/FR-11, and a T-01 gate pre-flight. Nothing was written to GitHub or the repository; map-resolutions.md carries the per-issue posting plan for when the user approves. Status 2026-10-08: T-35 was unblocked (D-046, D-065) and merged at 8958e06 after two approving review rounds; T-33 and T-34 remain unbuilt.

implementation_tickets.title: kitty OSC 72 drag tracking
implementation_tickets.goal: The Unix kitty handshake, the raw-stdin framer that owns stdin on kitty (legacy keys, SGR mouse, bracketed paste), and the OSC 72 protocol as published (move/leave/drop, required t=m:o= replies, chunked base64 data, t=R errors, file promises read before completion), with observed kitty framing accepted as tolerance only. implementation_tickets.interfaces: Handshake: write `ESC ] 72 ; t=q ST` then DA1 `ESC [ c`, read raw <= 300 ms; a t=q reply before DA1 -> opt in with `ESC ] 72 ; t=a ; text/uri-list ST` and the splitter owns stdin; otherwise never t=a and crossterm reads; non-reply bytes discarded and counted; `t=A` on every exit path incl. the panic hook. Framer: frames `ESC ] 72 ; metadata ; payload (ST|BEL)` (payload cap 4,096 B per frame, 1 MiB per drop), order-independent key=value metadata, unknown keys and i= tolerated, chunking on every event (m=1 continuation chunks may carry no other metadata). Protocol per plan §6 T-31: t=m -> CatEvent::DragAt(Some(cell)) and the reply `t=m:o=1 ; text/uri-list` (o=0 off the cat); x=-1:y=-1 -> DragAt(None); t=M -> `t=r:x=<index>`; data chunks concatenated then base64-decoded once (padding optional); RFC 2483 list, file:// only, host empty or localhost, percent-decoded, NUL rejected; every file read into memory (512 MiB guard) before `t=r:o=1`; t=R with any POSIX error name ends the drop with a hint; `t=r:o=0` after t=R.
